Everything insurance professionals need. In one workspace

01-05
Policy Builder

Build policies in a few clicks: terms, rates, coverage, and duration — all in one structured card. Documents generate automatically — no manual template filling. The full financial history, every change, and all documentation for each policy — in one place

02-05
Unified Workspace

Client cards, deal details, sales pipeline — all in one interface. Complete interaction history for every client, from first contact to closed deal

03-05
All Communications Inside the Deal

Email, chats, documents — right inside the client card. Correspondence history is saved automatically. No more switching tabs or digging through a shared inbox

04-05
Role-Based Access for Every Team Member

The underwriter sees one thing, the claims manager sees another, the head sees everything. Everyone works in their own space — data protected, order maintained

05-05
AI That Understands Insurance

Automatically parses incoming emails and documents. Summarises long communication threads. Analyses client profiles and suggests how to communicate more effectively

Kvilon was built
by people

who know insurance from the inside
Who we are
Behind kvilon is a team of specialists with years of hands-on experience in insurance and brokerage. We understand how underwriting works, how claims are handled, and what actually gets in the way of working efficiently — because we've been through it ourselves
Why we built it
That's why kvilon isn't a generic system adapted for insurance. It's a platform designed from the ground up for the real challenges of the insurance market: policies, underwriting, claims, and client management. Every feature is a direct answer to a problem we faced ourselves
Industry Expertise
A team with real experience in insurance and brokerage — not an IT company trying to figure out how insurance works
Results First
A product built for fast implementation and immediate value — not for feature count
Long-Term Thinking
We're starting with marine insurance — and building a platform for the entire insurance market

Geography: We work with clients in Singapore, Hong Kong, India, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, and Japan
